scope_note: The spec was authored as if the booking module and Shillinq were one repository. They are not: shillinq owns the DepositPayment register + webhook + reconciliation + AR-side materialisation. Booking-app Order/BookingType edits and live OpenConnector/AR wiring are deferred. See tasks.md preamble.
